subject: Music Production
title: What Is Sampling in Music
description: A quick win: understand What Is Sampling in Music.

hook.text: Sampling takes a piece of an existing recording and reuses it as an element in a new song.

buildup.text: A drum break, a vocal phrase, or a single chord can be lifted and rebuilt into something fresh.

discovery.text: Sampling connects generations of music, weaving old sounds into new creative expressions.

twist.text: Some of the most original-sounding hit songs are built almost entirely from other people's recordings.

climax.text: Sampling has shaped hip-hop, electronic, pop, and countless other genres for over four decades.

punchline.text: Old recordings become the building blocks of new hits.

quiz.question: What is sampling in music production?
options: Recording new instruments in a studio
Reusing a piece of an existing recording in a new song
Playing a song at a slower speed
